name: enthusiasm
quote: I heard the new album is great!
description: A desire to experience something that is expected to bring a positive reward of some type.

variations.name: social enthusiasm
variations.description: A big part of your interest in experiencing something is due to social factors.
examples: Yeah, it's a fad, but it's actually ok!
I'd like to go back to Yellowstone to show the kids.

variations.name: repeat enthusiasm
variations.description: If the experience is an old favorite, there may be an element of nostalgia or even identity.

conditions: You desire to experience something that is expected to bring a positive reward of some type.
